## SECTION 1: "WHAT CHANGED"

Three high-novelty developments warrant attention. First, **Strait of Hormuz disruption** (novelty 8) is materially redirecting global crude flows — this is an active structural shift in energy markets, not a tail risk. Second, a **direct contradiction** exists in Russian energy: one claim (July 1) says exports are rising despite drone strikes; another (July 2) says strikes have created genuine domestic fuel shortages forcing Russia to import gasoline from India and Belarus. These cannot both be fully true — treat the July 2 claim as the more specific and actionable update, implying Russian energy resilience is overstated. Third, **U.S. SMR leadership** (novelty 9) positions nuclear as a credible firm-power solution tied to AI data center demand — this is a structural theme with increasing source momentum. Korean liquidity stress data (truncated in feed) also flags emerging EM contagion risk via KRW/KTB simultaneous selloffs.

## SECTION 3: "DIVERGENCES & BLIND SPOTS"

**[CROWDED] EQUITY_VALUATION BEARISH (-7.5)**
Sources are heavily aligned that equities are overvalued. No data-side stress indicators are firing (spreads, vol, correlation breaks all silent per system status). Per DATA ASYMMETRY NOTE: absence of stress signals is implicitly bullish. Sources are bearish; market structure is not confirming. **Severity: 7/10.** This is the primary trap risk today — being short equities into a liquidity/stress-neutral environment because the narrative is bearish.

**[BLIND_SPOT] DOLLAR / KRW**
Dollar consensus is NO_DATA, yet the Korean positioning claim identifies $24B+ in pending equity outflows with simultaneous KRW and KTB deterioration. The market has a live EM contagion signal that sources are not covering adequately. **Severity: 7/10.** V16 liquidity regime should flag KRW stress as a leading indicator for broader EM risk-off.

**[CONTRARIAN] ENERGY BULLISH vs. TECH_AI BEARISH**
Sources are bullish energy (SMR nuclear, Hormuz disruption) while bearish tech/AI. The SMR claim explicitly ties nuclear buildout to AI data center power demand — this is a direct linkage that makes the tech/AI bearish consensus partially inconsistent. Nuclear-adjacent tech names may be mispriced. **Severity: 6/10.**

**[BLIND_SPOT] INFLATION — NO_DATA**
Hormuz closure redirecting crude flows + Russian domestic fuel shortages = live inflationary impulse in energy. Zero source coverage on inflation today. If CPI data were imminent (N/A per event calendar), this would be critical. Monitor for delayed coverage. **Severity: 5/10.**

**[BLIND_SPOT] RUSSIA ENERGY CONTRADICTION**
July 1 claim: Russian exports rising, resilient. July 2 claim: Russia importing gasoline from India/Belarus due to domestic shortages. The more granular July 2 data implies the "resilient Russia energy" narrative is outdated. Market participants still pricing Russian energy resilience may be wrong. **Severity: 6/10.**
